decisions.reason: A rye country bread sits squarely within the bakery's core know-how, so management can read early results and refine the recipe easily.
The premium raisin stollen is a flagship that has again won a gold medal from the Deutsches Brotinstitut, and it builds directly on the firm's confectionery expertise.
A seeded rye mixed bread extends the established bread range using existing skills, so there is little reason to drop it.
A dark barley malt rye bread is a variation on the firm's core rye baking, which the firm can assimilate and adjust, though it is somewhat more niche.
The marzipan stollen complements the seasonal stollen line and relies on established confectionery know-how and the gift-buying customer base.
The ancient grain bread is promoted as the newest master piece and draws on familiar grain and baking knowledge, so the firm can learn from its reception and keep it.
